exposure: high-grade intraepithelial lesions on Pap smear
outcome: Demographic and clinical characteristics of patients
cohort: 518 patients who underwent gynecological operations for benign diseases between January and June 2012 at a tertiary public hospital in Roraima, Brazil.
finding: Women undergoing gynecological operations for benign diseases had a mean age of 47 years, most had levels of basic education, came from the capital, were in stable relationships, predominantly housewives, multiparous and showed low operative complication rates.
mod_finding: This study mentions previous vaginal delivery and cesarean delivery in the study population but does not analyze outcomes based on mode of delivery.
